snippet.title: Blungo's Dungeon Luncheon (Trailer)
snippet.description:
Blungo is really hungry and his cousin Richie has some odd jobs for him if he wants to make some dough. Cousin Richie is a piece of work but he's an okay guy when you get to know him.

This game was made in about a month in my free time and after hours as a way to get my creativity flowing again. I hope you enjoy it.

Download for free:
https://cullendwyer.itch.io/blungo
